description: The ONE is provided by The ONE project. The ONE generates mobility traces and simulates delay-tolerant messaging with different routing protocols. It offers interactive visualisation, batch execution and configurable movement and reporting modules. Geographic context: global. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. Source code and documentation are linked through the public repository; no software was installed or executed. The cited material was readable without payment. Licence: GPL-3.0, read from the repository's licence file on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The reviewed README documents version 1.6.0 and legacy Java requirements. Current compatibility and mobility realism were not tested. Potential simulation use: Compare opportunistic routing and message delivery under intermittent contacts. For catalogue navigation, platform-ns-3 offers related simulation context; this comparison does not assert an implemented connection.
